note: Original token sets written for this corpus. They describe feels and mechanisms; they are NOT copied from any brand's DESIGN.md or official guidelines. The awesome-design-md pattern (a 9-section DESIGN.md) is the format inspiration only. If you adapt a real brand's system, write your own analysis and attribute the source.

colours.accent_role: One sharp accent: the single action, and nothing else.
colours.surface_role: Warm paper surface for secondary panels.

components.button: Solid ink button, white text, 2px radius, no shadow. Hover: accent background. Focus: 2px ink outline offset 2px.
components.card: No cards. Use rules (1px ink at 20% opacity) to separate sections.
components.heading: Fraunces 600, tight leading, ink. One size jump per level.

do: Use real photographs of the making process.
Let the paper colour carry the warmth.
Ration ornaments: one rule per section at most.
dont: Do not add gradient washes or glowing blobs.
Do not use purple or cyan anywhere.
Do not centre everything — the asymmetry is the design.
systems.name: Warm Workshop
systems.radius: 2px everywhere, with intent: nothing is pill-shaped.
systems.spacing: 8px base; sections 96px apart; text measure under 70 characters.

type.reason: Fraunces carries craft warmth; Newsreader is a calm, readable serif body.

colours.accent_role: One red: the single action per screen, and the one rule that matters.
colours.surface_role: Light grey for secondary surfaces only.

components.button: Solid black button, white text, 0 radius, uppercase 13px letterspaced. Hover: red. Focus: 2px black outline offset 2px.
components.card: No rounded cards. Panels are separated by the grid and by 1px rules.
components.heading: Archivo 700, uppercase or sentence case, tight leading.

do: Keep the grid visible in the layout.
Break the grid once per page, on purpose.
Use red only for the action.
dont: Do not add shadows, gradients or rounded corners.
Do not use a second accent colour.
Do not centre the hero. Left-aligned, always.
systems.name: Swiss Industrial

type.reason: One family, two weights, doing all the work — the grid, not the font, is the design.

colours.accent_role: Desaturated instrument green: live data and the single action only.
colours.surface_role: Slightly lighter panel for instruments and data tables.

components.button: Solid green button, near-black text, 4px radius. Hover: lighter green. Focus: 2px green outline offset 2px.
components.card: Flat panels, 1px border in ink at 15% opacity, 4px radius, no shadow.
components.heading: Space Grotesk 600, ink, tight leading.

do: Show live data, not marketing claims.
Use mono labels only for real data.
dont: Do not add neon glow or gradient text.
Do not use purple, cyan or magenta anywhere.
systems.name: Night Laboratory
systems.radius: 4px with intent; buttons and panels share one radius.
systems.spacing: 8px base; data tables with 16px row padding; sections 72px apart.

type.reason: Grotesk display for instrument precision; Plex body for readable data.

colours.accent_role: Deep muted green: the one quiet accent, used rarely.

components.button: Text button with a 1px underline, or a solid ink button with stone text. No shadow, no radius.
components.card: No cards. Space and rules separate content.
components.heading: Fraunces 500, generous leading, ink.

do: Leave space. The space is the design.
Use one image per screen, full-bleed if it earns it.
Let the type do the talking.
dont: Do not add a second accent.
Do not fill empty space with decoration.
Do not use more than two type sizes per screen.
systems.name: Quiet Luxury
systems.spacing: 8px base; sections 120px apart; text measure under 60 characters.

type.reason: Two serifs at different optical sizes: display with character, body with calm.

colours.accent_role: Hot coral: the hero field and the single action.
colours.surface_role: Flat yellow field for secondary highlights.

components.button: Solid coral button, white text, 999px radius, bold. Hover: darker coral. Focus: 2px ink outline offset 2px.
components.card: Rounded cards, one radius (24px), flat colour fields, no shadow.
components.heading: Bricolage Grotesque 700, loose leading, ink.

do: Use flat colour fields, not gradients or glows.
Keep one hero element bouncy; everything else still.
dont: Do not use purple gradients or neon.
Do not use more than three flat colours per screen.
Do not shrink type to fit — cut words instead.
systems.name: Playful Candy
systems.radius: 24px for cards, 999px for buttons — one radius system, used consistently.
systems.spacing: 8px base; sections 64px apart; type large and loose.

type.reason: Bricolage has a playful, slightly wonky character; Manrope keeps body copy clean.

colours.accent_role: Deep editorial red: datelines and the single action only.
colours.surface_role: Warm grey for secondary panels and rules.

components.button: Solid ink button, paper text, 0 radius. Hover: editorial red. Focus: 2px ink outline offset 2px.
components.card: No cards. Hairline rules (1px) separate sections.
components.heading: Libre Caslon Text 600, ink, generous leading.

do: Write headlines like a newspaper: specific, not clever.
dont: Do not use hairlines to frame emptiness.
Do not add a second accent.
Do not animate. Print does not move.
systems.name: Editorial Broadsheet
systems.radius: 0px. Print has no corners to round.
systems.spacing: 8px base; columns with 32px gutters; sections 88px apart.

type.reason: Caslon display for editorial authority; Newsreader body for long reading.
